URL: https://yougov.com/en-gb/articles/54772-political-favourability-ratings-may-2026
TITLE: Political favourability ratings, May 2026
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-14
SURVEY DATES: 12-13 May 2026

KEY TAKEAWAYS:
- Net favourability towards Keir Starmer (-46) is largely unchanged from last month
- Kemi Badenoch's latest net favourability score of -17 is her highest to date, as well as the highest of any Tory leader in five years
- 27% of Britons have a favourable opinion of Nigel Farage, while 64% see him unfavourably
- 50% of Britons now have a negative opinion of Zack Polanski, up sixteen points since last month
- Andy Burnham remains the most popular Labour figure among the public, with a net score of +4, and is the only figure a majority of 2024 Labour voters see positively

KEIR STARMER MAY 2026: 23% favourable, 69% unfavourable. Net -46.
KEMI BADENOCH MAY 2026: 31% favourable, 48% unfavourable. Net -17 — highest recorded for any Conservative leader since June 2021.
NIGEL FARAGE MAY 2026: 27% favourable, 64% unfavourable. Net -37.
ZACK POLANSKI MAY 2026: 23% favourable, 50% unfavourable, 27% don't know. Net -27 (down sixteen points since last month after Golders Green tweet controversy).
ED DAVEY MAY 2026: 29% favourable, 38% unfavourable. Net -9.

POTENTIAL LABOUR CHALLENGERS (May 2026 net favourability):
- Andy Burnham: net +4 — 34% favourable, 30% unfavourable. ONLY senior politician polled without a negative net rating.
- Angela Rayner: net -33 — 22% favourable, 55% unfavourable.
- Ed Miliband: net -32 — similar to Rayner.
- Yvette Cooper (Foreign Sec): net -21 — 17% favourable, 38% unfavourable.
- Wes Streeting: net -28 — 16% favourable, 44% unfavourable. (Net fell 8 points over last month.)
- Rachel Reeves: net -51 — 14% favourable, 65% unfavourable.
- Shabana Mahmood (Home Sec): net -29.

AMONG 2024 LABOUR VOTERS:
- Andy Burnham: 57% favourable, 16% unfavourable. Net +41.
- Angela Rayner: 46% favourable. Net +13.
- Ed Miliband: 44% favourable. Net +7.
- Yvette Cooper: 34% favourable. Net +12.
- Wes Streeting: 28% favourable. Net -9.
- Rachel Reeves: Net -21.

Burnham holds positive net ratings even among 2024 Lib Dem voters (+24) and Green voters (+18).

VOTING INTENTION (YouGov, 10-11 May 2026): Reform UK 28%, Conservative 17%, Green 16%, Labour 16%, Lib Dem 13%.
